newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore government securities market closed.
newsitem.headline: Singapore government securities market closed.

text.p: The Singapore government securities market is closed today for the Vesak Day holiday.
It will reopen on Thursday, May 22.

On Tuesday, in treasury bills, three-months closed at a yield of 2.55/2.50 percent compared with Monday's yield of 2.38/2.33 percent and one-year at a yield of 2.77/2.72 percent against 2.35/2.30 percent.
Among bonds, April 1999 ended at S$98.90/98.95 from Monday's close of S$99.05/99.10, September 2001 at S$96.40/96.50 versus S$96.50/96.60 and June 2003 at S$94.35/94.40 against S$94.40/94.45.
The overnight interbank offered rate rose to 4 3-7/8 percent from Monday's 3-7/8 3-3/4 percent.
